research.title: Oak National Academy — Read and write numbers with up to3 decimal places
research.read: Actual primaryHTML learning/keypoints/misconception/teacher tip and licence416–448, public quiz text corroborates multiple equivalent parts. No slides/video/PDF downloaded. One shared cluster search, not three separate searches.
research.adopted: Connect the same whole, decimal place chart and number words; teach zero placeholders and equivalent units, not reading by string length alone.
research.rejected: No English decimal point for Finnish display, compulsory speech, imported Year5 mandate, copied exercises or inferred learner efficacy.
research.licence: Inspected page states ©Oak2025 OGL3 except otherwise stated. No source prose/art/slides copied; original Finnish examples/diagrams/code.

research.title: NCETM1.24 — Composition and calculation: hundredths and thousandths
research.read: ActualHTML introduction and teachingpoints1–8 lines61–77. CopyrightHTML55–57 independently inspected at https://www.ncetm.org.uk/copyright/. Guide/representation downloads not opened.
research.adopted: Fixed-whole equal partitions and additive place-value composition; ten hundredths make a tenth and thousandths extend the same structure.
research.rejected: Column algorithms, rounding and timed mastery claims outside these three boundaries; no mandatory one-method response.
research.licence: NCETM default Crown/OGL subject to attribution and named-author/third-party exceptions. Conceptual comparison only; no protected figures/long text copied.

research.title: Kielitoimiston ohjepankki — Luvut ja numerot: desimaaliluvut
research.read: ActualHTML10–43 Finnish decimal notation/place labels and footer91–94. Linked licence opened: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/deed.fi .
research.adopted: Finnish display uses comma; whole part and decimal part remain distinct. Digital point input is a permitted input accommodation, not the recommended Finnish display convention.
research.rejected: No fullsource reproduction, translation/adaptation of protected prose or claim that language guidance proves teaching effectiveness.
research.licence: ©Kotimaisten kielten keskus2026; linked CC BY-NC-ND4.0. No reproduction/derivative permission assumed. Only notation facts corroborated; lesson prose, examples and SVG are original.

planning.scope: Nonnegative0..9,999, exact integer thousandths. Display Finnishcomma. Rawplainnumberinput max128characters; normalized atmost3nonzero decimal places, harmless extra zeros accepted. No approximation, exponent, fraction expression or arbitrary natural language parser.
